summary: Verified D1/D2/D3 refinement on top of prior Michael/Mike connect-flow fix. All 34 targeted backend pytest tests pass (test_connect_flow_refinement_2026_09_02.py 6/6, test_connect_bridge_close_delay_2026_09_01.py 1/1, plus 27 regression tests across admin diagnostic, onboarding nudge, github_app project add, business owner gates). All 10 frontend vitest tests pass across the 3 connect-flow files (NewUserWizard.connectRefinement 3/3, ConnectRepoBanner.reconciliation 4/4, useGitHubConnectStatus.repoSyncLag 3/3). Code-level verifications: (a) backend/routers/github_app.py _BRIDGE_HTML uses setTimeout(...,1200) at lines 779 and 793 -- 12000ms blocking beat fully removed; (b) backend/routers/cto_projects.py add_project raises HTTPException(409, {error:'already_connected', project_id, project_name}) at ~line 902 before dual-auth GitHub verification; (c) Revoots orphan-recovery block (_recovered_user_id) in github_app.py lines 322-423 confirmed untouched (only bridge close delay changed in that file); (d) NewUserWizard.jsx has successBeat + alreadyConnected states + testids wizard-success-beat / wizard-already-connected / wizard-open-existing-project-btn; (e) ConnectRepoBanner.jsx has successRepo + alreadyConnected states + testids connect-repo-banner-success-beat / connect-repo-banner-already-connected / connect-repo-banner-open-existing-btn. Frontend loads cleanly at /dashboard (redirects to sign-in, no runtime errors). No regressions detected. Ship-ready.
critical_code_review_comments: Refinement is scoped and clean: 409 duplicate check is placed before dual-auth GitHub verification (good -- avoids wasted API calls), uses case-insensitive owner/repo match, and returns project_id + project_name so UI can jump to existing project without extra lookup.
Bridge close delay change is purely presentational (12000 -> 1200); no side effects, Revoots recovery logic preserved.
Frontend success-beat + already-connected UI states are symmetric between NewUserWizard and ConnectRepoBanner -- good pattern consistency.
test_credentials: not needed for this scope; test creds available in /app/memory/test_credentials.md if needed
